threads_evidence: Reviewed C13 CPU matrix plan canonical endpoint 8074 uses 96 physical CPUs (0-95) with 96 threads and np1.
shape_justification: The actual architect_general CPU primary uses 96 physical threads, no SMT, NUMA interleave, np1, and context 262144 with F16 KV. The job verifies the whole-host CPU grant and its CPU GPU-fence. Four-CPU publisher smoke uses a separate small model.
estimate_justification: Six serial startup ceilings of 780 seconds, 24 serial request ceilings of 150 seconds, six captured-PID cleanup ceilings of 30 seconds, plus preflight, custody and deadline reserve fit in 9000 seconds. Stop as soon as three pairs complete.
baseline_ref: Same C13 CPU image bda43aa17 and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-IQ4_XS three-shard target in the compiled architect_general role recipe, with --spec-type none versus external shared Q8_0 draft-mtp n-max 4, p-min 0.5.
decision_rule: Does external shared Q8_0 MTP activate and preserve greedy token identity on the C13 architect_general CPU primary recipe (96 physical threads, np1, context 262144, F16 KV), and what decode throughput ratios are observed? Expect active drafting and a decode speed increase (higher tok/s is better). Three adjacent AB/BA/AB pairs of four sealed greedy 128-token prompts describe dispersion, not a formal confidence bound or a speed winner. Treat small differences such as 2% as unresolved. Keep each paired MTP/none decode ratio, raw token IDs and first disagreement, acceptance counts, exact recipe and during-request PID/image/all-TID CPU and foreign workload custody. Stop on answer after all three pairs and verified cleanup. Stop on futility at the first bad input, grant, foreign workload/unknown contention, startup, custody, request, token, activation, deadline, or cleanup. Short prompts measure early decode in the configured context pool.
smoke_note: Four keeper-assigned CPUs run one 32-token greedy request per arm with pinned Qwen3-0.6B Q8_0, first none and then an external draft-simple instance of the same model. Requires positive draft activation and acceptance for the latter, zero drafting for the former, raw token IDs, owned listener and mapped image/TID custody during both requests, captured-PID cleanup, and an attempt-bound receipt. This tests shared runner plumbing. Native external Qwen3.8 MTP is exercised only in the whole-host row.
